==Description==
'''End of the Line''' was a Wild West-style [[Maps|map]] created by Pixelates.

Players were rewarded with the [[Cowboy]] upon triumph. However, the mode had to be Normal, Hard or Insane, and it was not obtainable on Easy mode.

==Design & Path==
'''End of the Line''' took place in an expansive desert with a magma river running through the middle of the map. There were a lot of natural hills surrounding the map, including an overhang. Various cacti and rocks were dotted around the map. There was evidence of human habitation on the map with an abandoned railroad, a wooden bridge over the magma river and a wooden saloon. A crashed railcar could be seen by the buffers.

The path originated in the mines of the map before it meandered around the network of railroads. It then crossed the wooden bridge over the magma pool before curving back round to the saloon as a beige path.

==Strategy==
*Most of the towers should be placed at the start as this is where most of the corners are.
**Near the middle of the map, the path crosses a large magma pool. Ground towers cannot be placed near the path near this spot, meaning long-range towers are recommended if enemies get pass the first part of the map.
**You can also use the units from the [[Military Base]] and [[Crook Boss]] if the enemies go too far along the path.
